newsitem.title: ALBANIA: Albanian drives tractor into school group.
newsitem.headline: Albanian drives tractor into school group.

text.p: A man driving a tractor smashed into a schoolyard in eastern Albania on Wednesday, injuring six children before he was overpowered by villagers, Albania's Koha Jone newspaper said on Friday.
Two girls, aged seven and 11, were put in intensive care with broken bones and bleeding and doctors said their condition was stable, the paper reported.
"I will kill all the pupils. I will kill all the teachers," the daily quoted the man as saying just before the attack.
The man's motives were as yet unknown, the paper said.
